nom: NEOGEN Real Fresh Cleansing Stick Green Tea

segments.oily: One reviewer with an oily-sensitive perspective found it more stripping than expected though not troublesome, while another says it breaks through oil without leaving skin stripped.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-prone skin report no tightness or stripping, with one sensitive-dry reviewer recommending it specifically for that combination.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one who also describes herself as sensitive, say it cleans oily areas without drying out dry patches.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including one self-described as Asian sensitive skin, generally report gentle cleansing without irritation, though one sensitive-oily reviewer found it somewhat more stripping than expected.
segments.mature: One reviewer states it is effective for mature skin, alongside noting it helped a teenager's acne-prone skin.

concerns.aging: One reviewer looking to slow aging values the green tea antioxidant content and says it doesn't irritate her the way vitamin C products do; no other aging-specific outcomes are reported.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report no dryness or tightness after cleansing, with several explicitly saying it feels hydrating rather than stripping; one reviewer, however, states it did leave her skin feeling tight, and one sensitive-oily reviewer found it more stripping than expected.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers report reduced redness with regular use, and one combination-sensitive reviewer noticed her skin was calmer with less redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as non-stripping and balancing rather than harsh, with several contrasting it favorably to foam cleansers that dried them out.
concerns.spots: One reviewer says her pores look noticeably smaller and another reports it minimizes imperfections and cleans pores deeply.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report improvement in acne, including one whose chin acne cleared, one whose cousin's acne cleared, and one teenager with acne-prone skin who noticed positive effects; one simply reports no new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer says it breaks through oil easily without stripping, and combination-skin reviewers note it cleans oily areas well while leaving dry areas untouched.

Creamy lather from stick to foam
Green tea leaves provide gentle exfoliation

Higher price seen as worth it

extraits.texte: Very gentle facial cleanser in a travel- friendly package. I apply it to wet skin and use a small silicone scrubbi to dispurse and cleanse across all areas of my face. The cleanser rinses off easily with warm water. Wish it were possible to get the soap refills to reinstall in the plastic dispenser once the product is finished, but at least the package is recyclable. Recently shared this item with my teenager. After sampling it, he asked for his own: he immediately noticed positive effects on his acne prone skin. It is equally effective for mature skin.

This gentle and refreshing cleanser is really good at cleansing the face without stripping. I prefer green tea for my cleanser and this one along with Neogen's other green tea cleanser are my favorite. I have a sensitive and dry skin and I definitely recommend it for those who have the same skin type with me. It goes much longer than many other stick type cleanser I used before. Amazing product!

I've used this cleanser for around two years, I love it so much. It helps with my redness and makes my skin feel and look amazing. It takes a good amount of time to use the whole stick since it's a solid, so it's well worth the price. The foam cleanser version of this dries out my skin, but that's not the case with this product. Super easy to travel with, and convenient to use. I've never used a stick cleanser before this, and I'll never go back if I can help it. I have sensitive skin prone to dryness, and this does wonders for me. If this is in stock, then do yourself a favor and get it before it's gone.

It leaves my sensitive skin so smooth and clean and refreshed. I gave one to a cousin and her acne cleared. She loves it too.

Very effective (second) cleanser that I consider a nearly must-have when traveling because it doesn't count as a liquid on flights. I found it to be more stripping than I thought but not to a troublesome extent at all. (oily sensitive skin perspective)

I was gifted this cleanser in exchange for my honest review. I really love the added little leaves in this cleanser and it felt very refreshing. They said it is not supposed to leave your skin tight but I definitely thought it did. complimentary from neogen.
